record.question: Which one of the following counsellors is elected from the general ward (unreserved category) in the last Aizawl Municipal Corporation (AMC) election held on February 2021?
record.explanation: B. Lalawmpuii won Ward IX in the February 2021 AMC election. The contemporary election report identifies Wards IX and XV as the general seats won by women; the other listed candidates won reserved Wards X, III and XIV: https://lenkawl.khampat.com/2021/02/amc-inthlanpui-ah-mnf-in-party-mal.html
